summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc., a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer (formerly K Wave Media Ltd.) listed on the NYSE, furnished a Form 6-K reporting the dismissal of Samil PricewaterhouseCoopers as independent registered public accounting firm effective September 21, 2026, and the appointment of HTL International, LLC as successor auditor effective October 1, 2026. The Audit Committee approved both actions. The former auditor's reports for fiscal 2024 and 2025 were unqualified, though fiscal 2025 contained a going-concern explanatory paragraph. Disclosed material weaknesses relate to insufficient IFRS/SEC reporting personnel and no formal risk assessment process. No special-situations transaction is implicated.
